name: PRISONER
source:
Future with electronic core and idyllic facade. Artificial life named "Metafima" is created. They start to help humans with various home duties. Main character does not trust metafima at first, but seeing their cuteness and obedience, he starts to value them. It gradually grows into master-slave relationship.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一个拥有电子核心、表面田园宁静的未来。名为“梅塔菲玛”的人工生命被创造出来，开始协助人类处理各类家务。主人公起初不信任梅塔菲玛，但看到它们可爱又顺从，逐渐开始珍视它们。这份感情渐渐发展为主从关系。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
